title: Aptar Beauty expands its range of all-plastic cosmetic pumps
summary: The specialist in dispensing solutions for fragrance and beauty is launching Novus Advance, an all-plastic pump designed for hair and body care applications. The new solution expands the group's Advance platform of all-polyolefin pumps, developed to enhance recyclability. Aptar Beauty expands its Advance Collection, a new generation of all-plastic pumps designed to maximize recyclability.
